test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

MRFL, RYKS, ?, BMUG, GTZN
solution:
**Given:**

MRFL, RYKS, ?, BMUG, GTZN

**Logic: **(5) is added to the first and third letters and (7) is added to the second and fourth letters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cdd94ccebe2cbaa166332e106cb3da5a767df1f489d832a833e84749140c3dd.png] 

Here, **'WFPZ'** is the missing term.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
